requirements.invariant: This reusable provider-free primitive validates explicit source, target, Account, mode, artifact/contract and no-credential identity/environment evidence and defaults an omitted raw request mode into an explicit canonical dry_run value. It is a prerequisite, not proof that a future migration entry point invokes it before access. A separate sole-executor/composition slice must make provider construction require its opaque token and prove that structural ordering before operational completion can be claimed.

The package-visible guard revalidates one canonical MigrationRunPlan under a package-visible initial-consistency policy and independently matches its source snapshot, validated target binding, Account-scope hash, mode, repository/artifact/mapping/contract identities, and explicit none/none credential descriptors before yielding a package-visible process-local MigrationPreflightConsistencyToken. The token initializer is private, the token is non-Codable/non-Encodable/non-Decodable, cannot reconstruct across restart, and is outside ordinary public client API while remaining consumable by a later executor target in this Swift package. Public MigrationRunPlanPolicy construction, plan construction, evidence-only apply shape or a consistency token is never operational authorization; the future sole executor must match against its own independently trusted compile-time/runtime policy before provider construction.

This initial guard admits only source_fixture plus targetLocal plus dry_run plus explicit no-source-credential and no-target-credential descriptors. Missing mode normalizes to dry_run. Apply, sourceProduction, targetStaging, targetProduction, any credential, hosted identifier, production identifier, implicit project/bucket, all-Account selection, and environment fallback are refused.

The primitive accepts only already-constructed immutable provider-free values and exposes no closure, provider handle, credential material, path, URL, filesystem payload, database, network, Auth, Storage, exporter, transformer, loader, reconciler or general callback. Rejection yields no token or accepted state; successful validation still performs zero access. Structural enforcement at provider construction is deferred to the separately tracked sole-executor/composition slice.

Schema-v1 raw request is limited to 65536 bytes before JSON decoding, rejects unknown keys, carries canonical plan bytes as padded RFC-4648 base64 plus exact fixture/target/Account/artifact/contract/credential evidence, and normalizes omitted mode to explicit dry_run; normalized canonical request content is at most 49152 bytes. Schema-v1 initial-policy content is at most 32768 canonical bytes and contains exactly source_fixture, targetLocal, dry_run, none/none credentials, expected source snapshot/bundle identity, target binding hashes, Account-scope hash, repository revision, migration artifact identity, sorted unique mapping artifact identities, exact schema/query/operation/sync versions, and evidence_only disposition. Its digest preimage is ASCII `ledger.migration-preflight-policy.v1` plus NUL, UInt64 big-endian canonical-content length and bytes; an optional policy envelope is at most 33024 raw bytes before decoding and rejects unknown keys. Schema-v1 receipt content is at most 4096 canonical bytes and contains exactly plan digest, policy digest, fixture bundle digest, target manifest digest, Account-scope hash, source_fixture, targetLocal, dry_run, none/none credentials and evidence_only disposition. Receipt digest uses the same length framing with domain `ledger.migration-preflight-receipt.v1`; a receipt envelope is at most 4352 raw bytes before decoding, rejects unknown keys, and contains only content plus digest. A successful preflight yields that Codable evidence-only receipt plus a package-visible ephemeral consistency token binding the same digests. Receipt decode cannot recreate the private-initializer token. Failures expose stable non-secret codes; neither result contains raw Account, environment resource, credential, provider, path, URL, payload, operator, or production identity.

The provider-free guard cannot export, transform, load, persist a journal, sign or approve a plan, authorize apply, execute/resume/abort/rollback migration, activate a feature/environment, access hosted or production systems, change the Firebase app, release, or cut over. Any later hosted or production policy and executor require separate reviewed authority and rehearsal evidence.

verification.expected: Only the exact source_fixture/targetLocal/dry_run/none-none tuple validates; omitted raw mode canonicalizes to dry_run; the receipt and ephemeral token bind exact canonical plan and initial-consistency-policy digests. Compile-time/package-interface checks prove guard/policy/token are package-visible rather than public, the token initializer is private, and token is non-Codable/non-Encodable/non-Decodable with no reconstruction API.

Golden vectors prove exact schema-v1 request normalization and policy/receipt canonical bytes, UInt64 length framing, domains and digests. Canonical request/policy/receipt evidence reconstructs byte-identically; changed order normalizes deterministically and every content/digest/version/unknown-field mutation fails. Raw 65536/33024/4352 and canonical 49152/32768/4096 ceilings plus pre-decode rejection pass. Receipt restart never recreates the process-local token, and no test calls the token authorization.

Each source/fixture hash/target/resource/Account/mode/repository/migration artifact/mapping set/contract/credential/canonical/digest/size mismatch, plus sourceProduction, targetStaging/Production, apply, any credential, hosted/production/default identifier, all-Account and fallback attempt, fails atomically with one bounded code and no token.

API and encoded-shape tests prove request, package policy and receipt contain only immutable provider-free evidence and no closure/handle/path/URL/secret or executor hook; every refusal returns no token and success yields only a package-visible non-Codable process-local consistency token with private initializer while performing zero migration work. The public module interface excludes guard/policy/token. This test makes no provider-construction ordering or trust claim.

A complete Cartesian single-mismatch matrix proves the request, canonical plan, internal initial-consistency policy, fixture identity, validated target and credential descriptors agree exactly; no missing or extra field is tolerated and no rejected case records partial acceptance or operational trust.

notes: READY package only; executable implementation remains unopened until the exact READY checkpoint passes immutable CI. Four independent adversarial review rounds drove corrections to primitive-versus-executor scope, consistency-versus-trust, package visibility/private construction, exact request/policy/receipt canonical schemas/digests and raw/canonical ceilings; final review returned GO with no P0-P3 finding. Both Swift leaves remain comment-only, and the checker fails if either becomes executable before implementation begins. This slice is only a provider-free preflight consistency primitive, not a migration entry point or integrated operational guard. The separately tracked same-package sole forward-executor/composition slice must own independently trusted policy and structurally require the opaque token plus exact policy match at every provider constructor before operational enforcement may be claimed. The initial policy rejects apply, production, hosted targets and all credentials; an omitted raw mode becomes explicit dry_run before canonical validation. O-022 and A-003/A-004 block later source freeze/hosted rehearsal/cutover, not this local primitive, but remain unadvanced.
